-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"

	a "example.com/internal/api"
	"example.com/internal/database"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var source embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(source, "*"))

type GlobalType struct {
	Field1 int
}

func main() {
	// inline data type
	var d1 struct {
		Field2 int
	}
	_ = templates.ExecuteTemplate(io.Discard, "template.gohtml", d1)

	// globally scoped type
	var d2 GlobalType
	_ = templates.ExecuteTemplate(io.Discard, "template.gohtml", d2)

	// globally scoped type
	var d3 db.Row
	_ = templates.ExecuteTemplate(io.Discard, "template.gohtml", d3)

	// globally scoped type
	// TODO: fix this, it should use 'a' not 'api'
	var d4 a.Body
	_ = templates.ExecuteTemplate(io.Discard, "template.gohtml", d4)
}
-- internal/database/types.go --
package db

type Row struct {
	Column3 int
}
-- internal/api/types.go --
package api

type Body struct {
	Field4 int
}
